_readme: Golden regression cases for --mode community-opinion (Reddit/forum/X/HN discussion). Verifies peer-review is off, engagement is weighted highest, and the trusted_people bonus (modes/community_opinion.json) fires only for a matched x.com/twitter.com handle. Run with `python3 scripts/check_policy.py`; re-baseline with `--bless` after a deliberate policy change.
